cards.card_text: They say giving their sister to an uncircumcised man would be a disgrace to them.
cards.verse_text: “To give our sister to an uncircumcised man would be a disgrace to us.
cards.snippet: “To give our sister to an uncircumcised man would be a disgrace to us.

cards.card_text: What if they confess their iniquity and their fathers' iniquity, and their uncircumcised hearts are humbled and they make amends?
cards.verse_text: But if they will confess their iniquity and that of their fathers in the unfaithfulness that they practiced against Me, by which they have also walked in hostility toward Me— and I acted with hostility toward them and brought them into the land of their enemies—and if their uncircumcised hearts will be humbled and they will make amends for their iniquity,
cards.snippet: …them and brought them into the land of their enemies—and if their uncircumcised hearts will be humbled and they will make amends for their iniquity,

cards.card_text: Jonathan turns to his armor-bearer again: “Come, let us cross over to the outpost of these uncircumcised men.” And the plan comes with a PERHAPS: “Perhaps the LORD will work on our behalf.”
cards.verse_text: Jonathan said to the young man bearing his armor, “Come, let us cross over to the outpost of these uncircumcised men.
cards.snippet: …his armor, “Come, let us cross over to the outpost of these uncircumcised men.

cards.card_text: Then David asks a second question: just who is this uncircumcised Philistine?
cards.verse_text: Just who is this uncircumcised Philistine, that he should defy the armies of the living God?”
cards.snippet: Just who is this uncircumcised Philistine, that he should defy the armies of the living God?”

cards.card_text: David says he's killed lions and bears, and this uncircumcised Philistine will be like one of them.
cards.verse_text: Your servant has killed lions and bears; this uncircumcised Philistine will be like one of them, for he has defied the armies of the living God.”

cards.card_text: The prophet says the uncircumcised and unclean will keep coming into Jerusalem, the holy city.
cards.verse_text: For the uncircumcised and unclean will no longer enter you.
cards.snippet: For the uncircumcised and unclean will no longer enter you.

cards.card_text: And the LORD says all these nations are uncircumcised.
cards.verse_text: For all these nations are uncircumcised, and the whole house of Israel is uncircumcised in heart.”
cards.snippet: For all these nations are uncircumcised, and the whole house of Israel is uncircumcised in heart.”

cards.card_text: The LORD says they are uncircumcised in ___.
cards.verse_text: For all these nations are uncircumcised, and the whole house of Israel is uncircumcised in heart.”
cards.snippet: For all these nations are uncircumcised, and the whole house of Israel is uncircumcised in heart.”

cards.card_text: Then God asks, “Will you still say, ‘I am a god,’ in the presence of those who slay you?” God says he will be only a man, and he will die the death of the uncircumcised at the hands of foreigners.
cards.verse_text: You will die the death of the uncircumcised at the hands of foreigners.
cards.snippet: You will die the death of the uncircumcised at the hands of foreigners.

cards.card_text: The uncircumcised The kings of Israel Their own ancestors
cards.verse_text: Go down and be placed with the uncircumcised!
cards.snippet: Go down and be placed with the uncircumcised!

cards.card_text: From the middle of Sheol, someone speaks up about Egypt and her allies: "They have come down and lie with the uncircumcised, with those slain by the sword."
cards.verse_text: Mighty chiefs will speak from the midst of Sheol about Egypt and her allies: ‘They have come down and lie with the uncircumcised, with those slain by the sword.’
cards.snippet: …Egypt and her allies: ‘They have come down and lie with the uncircumcised, with those slain by the sword.’

cards.card_text: So Pharaoh and all his multitude will be laid to rest among the uncircumcised, with those slain by the sword, declares the Lord GOD.
cards.verse_text: For I will spread My terror in the land of the living, so that Pharaoh and all his multitude will be laid to rest among the uncircumcised, with those slain by the sword, declares the Lord GOD.”
cards.snippet: …Pharaoh and all his multitude will be laid to rest among the uncircumcised, with those slain by the sword, declares the Lord GOD.”

cards.card_text: Foreigners uncircumcised in heart and flesh Priests of Baal from Samaria Soldiers sent by the king of Babylon
cards.verse_text: In addition to all your other abominations, you brought in foreigners uncircumcised in both heart and flesh to occupy My sanctuary; you defiled My temple when you offered My food—the fat and the blood; you broke My covenant.
cards.snippet: In addition to all your other abominations, you brought in foreigners uncircumcised in both heart and flesh to occupy My sanctuary; you defiled My…

cards.card_text: The Lord GOD says even a foreigner who lives among the Israelites may not enter His sanctuary if he is uncircumcised in heart and flesh.
cards.verse_text: This is what the Lord GOD says: No foreigner uncircumcised in heart and flesh may enter My sanctuary—not even a foreigner who lives among the Israelites.

cards.card_text: No warm-up, no "with all due respect," just: "You stiff-necked people with uncircumcised hearts and ears!"
cards.verse_text: You stiff-necked people with uncircumcised hearts and ears!
cards.snippet: You stiff-necked people with uncircumcised hearts and ears!

cards.card_text: He visited uncircumcised men and ate with them He baptized people without asking the apostles He stayed away from Jerusalem far too long
cards.verse_text: and said, “You visited uncircumcised men and ate with them.”
cards.snippet: and said, “You visited uncircumcised men and ate with them.”

cards.card_text: Paul says the physically uncircumcised man who keeps the law will ___ the lawbreaker who has the written code and circumcision.
cards.verse_text: The one who is physically uncircumcised yet keeps the law will condemn you who, even though you have the written code and circumcision, are a lawbreaker.

cards.card_text: And that one God will justify both the circumcised and the uncircumcised.
cards.verse_text: since there is only one God, who will justify the circumcised by faith and the uncircumcised through that same faith.
cards.snippet: …only one God, who will justify the circumcised by faith and the uncircumcised through that same faith.

cards.card_text: God will justify the circumcised by faith and the uncircumcised through ___ faith.
cards.verse_text: since there is only one God, who will justify the circumcised by faith and the uncircumcised through that same faith.
cards.snippet: …only one God, who will justify the circumcised by faith and the uncircumcised through that same faith.

cards.card_text: Now Paul asks a sharp question: is this blessing only for the circumcised, or for the uncircumcised too?
cards.verse_text: Is this blessing only on the circumcised, or also on the uncircumcised?
cards.snippet: Is this blessing only on the circumcised, or also on the uncircumcised?

cards.card_text: If a man was still uncircumcised when God called him, Paul says he should get circumcised.
cards.verse_text: He should not become uncircumcised.
cards.snippet: He should not become uncircumcised.

cards.card_text: Now he tells the Gentiles to remember that they were called uncircumcised by the so-called circumcision, which was done in the body by human hands.
cards.verse_text: Therefore remember that formerly you who are Gentiles in the flesh and called uncircumcised by the so-called circumcision (that done in the body by human hands)—
cards.snippet: …remember that formerly you who are Gentiles in the flesh and called uncircumcised by the so-called circumcision (that done in the body by human hands)—

cards.card_text: Here, Paul says, there's no Greek or Jew, circumcised or uncircumcised, barbarian, Scythian, slave or free.
cards.verse_text: Here there is no Greek or Jew, circumcised or uncircumcised, barbarian, Scythian, slave, or free, but Christ is all and is in all.
